messages:
devon: heads-up — i sketched a 'cost surface' card for the console that overlays per-model token burn, cache-savings, and routing decisions. thinking about showing where routing policy spikes cause unexpected token spend. want thoughts.

maria: ooh nice. curious about the granularity — per-route? per-tenant? per-model-sku?

devon: main idea is per-route + breakdown by model sku + a separate column for cache delta (est. saved tokens). per-tenant would be a filter, not default.

alex: two quick concerns: 1) how do we attribute shared cache saves when a request hits a prefetch vs hotpath? 2) perf of the query for the dashboard.

devon: exactly. for attribution i was thinking a heuristic: if KV hit from prefix cache within 30s of prefetch event, give X% credit to prefetching route, else to hotpath. rough but actionable.

jess: can we avoid inventing credit rules before we have telemetry? i'd rather show both raw metrics and a 'suggested attribution' toggle.

devon: agreed. UI will default to raw numbers + an opt-in 'attribution view'.

alex: for perf, here's a draft query for the telemetry team to optimize (postgres example):
```sql
SELECT route_id, model_sku, SUM(tokens_consumed) as tokens,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cache_hit THEN tokens_saved ELSE 0 END) as estimated_cache_saved,
  COUNT(*) as requests
FROM token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN now() - interval '1d' AND now()
GROUP BY route_id, model_sku;
```
we should probably pre-aggregate into daily slices to keep the console snappy.

sre-bot: alert: high-cardinality query detected in dashboard prototype (estimated 12k grouping rows). recommend materialized view.

maria: nice flag. also want an SLA overlay for Dedicated customers — their per-token cost baseline is different, we should show model-sku adjusted unit cost.

devon: good call. we'll multiply tokens by model_sku_unit_cost to produce $ burn. show both tokens and $ columns.

jess: for the attribution toggle, let's include a short explainer tooltip:
"Attribution heuristic: assigns shared cache saves to the most recent prefetching route within 30s. Toggle to view raw counts."

alex: UX nit — include a small sparkline of token rate and a dropdown to simulate routing fallbacks (e.g., move 10% traffic to cheaper model) so PMs can estimate savings.

devon: simulation slider is awesome. implementation plan: backend pre-agg + feature flag for simulation. can someone mock up the API surface? i was thinking: POST /internal/console/cost-simulate { route_id, shift: [{from_sku,to_sku,percent}] } -> {estimated_tokens,estimated_cost_delta} 

maria: i can draft the api contract. adding to my todo.

ops-bot: deploy-note: perf-dashboard-v0 pushed to staging at 11:02 UTC. watch console logs for slow queries.

alex: one more: add a 'why this spike' quick view that links to recent routing policy changes and rollouts (canary percent changes). helps SREs triage.

devon: love it. i'll add a pointer to routing-change events in the model-sidecard.

jess: ok next steps: maria writes API schema, alex pairs with infra on materialized view, devon wires UI mock, i'll write tooltip copy and UX microcopy.

maria: timeline? aim for staging demo next week?

devon: yes — staging by Thu. thanks all :thumbsup:
